newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN STATE BUDGET GAP RISES IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN STATE BUDGET GAP RISES IN JULY.

text.p: Romania's state budget deficit widened in July pushing its 1996 seven-month figure to 1.66 trillion lei from 1.24 trillion over January-June, official data showed on Monday.
January-July expenditure stood at 11.29 trillion lei, up from 9.5 trillion lei at end-June, a central bank report said.
It showed state revenues had risen to 9.63 trillion lei at end-July from 8.26 trillion in the first six months of 1996.
The report gave no other details and no dollar equivalents.
On Monday the leu's reference rate was 3,196 to the dollar.

Last month the government revised the 1996 state budget bringing it in line with higher inflation and costs. The deficit for the whole year was forecast at 4.27 trillion lei, up from a previous estimate of 3.19 trillion.
Under the revised budget, spending is put at 24.14 trillion lei and revenues at 19.87 trillion. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
